i.norm: Two X5455 extended-timestamp fields whose flags and timestamps differ must not be considered equal: - the first field only has its flags byte set (no timestamp values), - the second field has a create time set, which both turns on the create-time bit and stores a ZipLong value. Because their create-time presence and stored values differ, equals() returns false.
Setting a non-null create time turns on the create-time presence bit.
